ev.q: GPLN tested 234,521 stool specimens from AFP cases during January 2007--June 2008
a 12% increase in workload compared with the previous 18-month period
1,257 (86%) of 1,470 WPV1 isolates and 2,444 (97%) of 2,518 WPV3 isolates
increased from 36% to 95% in the Eastern Mediterranean region
Most (90%) AFP specimens were from the polio-endemic WHO regions
a 12% increase in workload compared with the previous 18-month period
increased from 36% to 95% in the Eastern Mediterranean region
GPLN routinely screens for and characterizes VDPVs
Data from GPLN also are evaluated to determine progress toward polio eradication

methods_quotes.q: Nucleotide sequences (viral capsid protein VP1 region; 900--906 nucleotides) are determined for wild poliovirus (WPV) isolates from each patient
Isolates are sequenced if results from ITD tests based on genetic and antigenic properties are discordant
WHO monitors GPLN performance through an annual laboratory accreditation program that uses proficiency testing
Reported within 14 days for laboratories in the regions of Africa, Americas, and Eastern Mediterranean
